log.name: Log
log.description: A freshly cut log. Burns in the campfire or grinds into wood.

wood.name: Wood
wood.description: Processed planks used in nearly every recipe.

sapling.name: Sapling
sapling.description: A young tree. Plant it to grow a new tree.

tire.name: Tire
tire.description: A worn rubber tyre. Grinds into scrap.

bolt.name: Bolt
bolt.description: A loose bolt. Grinds into scrap.

sheet_metal.name: Sheet Metal
sheet_metal.description: A crumpled metal sheet. Grinds into scrap.

broken_machinery.name: Broken Machinery
broken_machinery.description: Dead machinery. Grinds into plenty of scrap.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: A battery radio that only hisses static. Grinds into scrap.

coal.name: Coal
coal.description: Black stones that burn far longer than wood.

fuel_canister.name: Fuel Canister
fuel_canister.description: A pressurised canister of fuel. Found in chests and buildings.

biofuel.name: Biofuel
biofuel.description: Processed crop fuel made in the Biofuel Processor.

oil_barrel.name: Oil Barrel
oil_barrel.description: A heavy barrel of oil. Produced by the Oil Drill.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.description: A crunchy carrot. Grown on farm plots.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.description: A hefty pumpkin that glows faintly at night.

chili.name: Chili
chili.description: A fiery chili that grants a burst of energy.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: A crisp apple from an orchard tree.

raw_meat.name: Raw Meat
raw_meat.description: Raw meat. Cook it on the campfire before eating.

hearty_stew.name: Hearty Stew
hearty_stew.description: A rich stew cooked in the Crock Pot.

bunny_foot.name: Bunny Foot
bunny_foot.description: A lucky token from a trapped bunny.

pelt.name: Pelt
pelt.description: An animal pelt, prized by traders.

cultist_gem.name: Cultist Gem
cultist_gem.description: A cold gem taken from a cultist. Used in advanced crafting.

forest_gem_fragment.name: Forest Gem Fragment
forest_gem_fragment.description: One of four fragments of the Gem of the Forest.

forest_gem.name: Gem of the Forest
forest_gem.description: The reunited heart of the forest, assembled from four fragments.

old_axe.name: Old Axe
old_axe.description: A rusty starting axe. Slow, but it fells trees.

good_axe.name: Good Axe
good_axe.description: A reliable axe that bites deep.

strong_axe.name: Strong Axe
strong_axe.description: A fireman's axe. Fells a normal tree in a single blow.

ice_axe.name: Ice Axe
ice_axe.description: A frozen axe that chills whatever it strikes.

chainsaw.name: Chainsaw
chainsaw.description: Roars through trees with continuous damage.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.description: A beam of light that briefly stuns the forest's hunters.
